title: Dashboard framework: MetricDefinitions, filters, drill endpoint, shared chart/KPI components
objective: The shared backbone all five dashboards build on: isolated metric formula classes (Q-4/Q-5, §9.6), common filter contract, drill-through endpoint, and the frontend dashboard component kit with the fixed chart palettes (spec FR-54, §9.6, §12.7 contracts).
scope: Domain/Metrics/MetricDefinitions.cs — every PRD 22 formula as a named, documented, unit-tested method
DashboardFilter model binding (from,to,productLineId,brokerId,rmUserId,regionId,teamOrRmId,brokerTypeId) + prior-period comparison helper

Frontend kit: FilterBar, KpiCard (direction-aware deltas), ChartCard (contextual link + ⋮ menu), StatusChip final (reporting-category palette), chart wrappers (bar/donut/line/funnel/scatter/heatmap) on Recharts (MIT), product-line series palette + quadrant palette constants, drill navigation helper, generatedAt footer wiring
dashboardFilters Redux persistence across dashboard routes (A-16)
implementation_details: Domain/Metrics/MetricDefinitions.cs: static pure methods over snapshot inputs — ConversionRate(wonQuotes, decidedQuotes) [Q-4: won ÷ decided], LeadToQuoteRate(leadsWithQuote, eligibleLeads), QuoteToProposalRate(quotesSent, totalQuotes) [Q-5: quote denominator], ProposalToWinRate(won, sent), AverageLeadAgeDays, AverageQuoteAgeDays, AverageTurnaroundDays(receivedToSentPairs), FollowUpCompliance(onTime, required), OpenPipelinePremium(openQuotePremium, openLeadEstimates); each with XML-doc stating the agreed business definition so SQL implementations reference it (§9.6)

Application/Dashboards/DashboardFilter.cs + DashboardPeriod.cs (current vs prior comparable period derivation for deltas); KpiValue record {value, delta, goodDirection} — delta coloring decided by goodDirection declared per KPI (UI standards 3.4)

Features/Dashboards/Drill/GetDrillQuery{widget key, filter} with a registry mapping widget keys (e.g., 'exec.pipeline_by_stage', 'pipeline.aging_cell') to parameterized row queries returning the shared lead/quote row DTOs (reuses LeadsTable columns)

Frontend: components/dashboards/FilterBar.tsx (date range picker with presets, dropdowns default All, Clear filters; variant prop for RM/Team + Broker Type on RM Performance); KpiCard.tsx (tinted icon halo, label, value, delta arrow colored by goodDirection); ChartCard.tsx (title, link slot 'View … →', ⋮ menu with Export/View details); charts/*.tsx thin Recharts wrappers with token-based theming, series palette map {Motor:'--qiq-series-motor',...} and quadrant palette from UI standards; Heatmap as CSS-grid table with graded backgrounds; Funnel as tapered bars; compact currency formatter (BWP 128.6M) + full formatter utilities using tenant currency
StatusChip.tsx final: color by reporting category (open info, quoted accent, won success, lost danger, expired neutral, withdrawn neutral-outlined)
useDrill(widgetKey) hook navigating to a generic DrillListPage rendering returned rows with the leads table

e2e: dashboard-framework.spec.ts: filters persist when navigating between two dashboard routes; Clear filters resets; KPI delta renders green for good-direction movement
